expect.fees: Olympic NP entrance: $30/vehicle or $15/person for 7 days, $55 annual Olympic pass (nps.gov/olym, 2026 rates). Overnight wilderness camping permit for Flapjack Lakes (a quota/limited-entry area including Gladys Divide) costs a $6 Recreation.gov reservation fee plus $8/person/night (16+, free under 16); summer-season (May 15–Oct 15) permits release April 15 and this is one of the park's highest-demand backcountry zones.
expect.notes: No separate climbing cost-recovery fee like Mount Rainier’s $82 — only the standard entrance fee and wilderness camping permit apply.
expect.rules: Flapjack Lakes is a quota/limited-use area — no same-day walk-up permits once the season sells out; groups capped at 12, parties of 7+ must use designated group campsites; stick to your permitted itinerary except in emergencies.
expect.permit: NPS wilderness/backcountry permit required for any overnight camping at Flapjack Lakes or Gladys Divide, booked in advance on Recreation.gov (Wilderness Information Center, 360-565-3100); no separate climbing permit is needed once past the park boundary into the Mount Skokomish Wilderness.
expect.closures: IMPORTANT (current as of mid-2026): the entire standard approach — Staircase entrance, North Fork Skokomish River Trail, Flapjack Lakes Trail, and the nearby Mildred Lakes Trail (an alternate approach) — is closed following the 2025 Bear Gulch Fire on the slopes above Lake Cushman (fire fully contained Nov 12, 2025, but rockfall/treefall/landslide hazard remains in the burn scar). NPS and Olympic National Forest closure orders remain in effect (through at least Oct 1, 2026 per USFS order 06-09-25-11); Lake Cushman Rd/Forest Road 24 access is also closed. There is currently no legal approach to Mount Cruiser via Flapjack Lakes — check NPS Olympic 'Fire Conditions and Updates' and Olympic National Forest alerts before planning a trip.
expect.landManager: Approach trail (Staircase, North Fork Skokomish River Trail, Flapjack Lakes Trail, Gladys Divide) is within Olympic National Park (NPS); the summit and Sawtooth Ridge itself sit just south of the park boundary in the Mount Skokomish Wilderness, Olympic National Forest.
expect.land_manager: U.S. Forest Service -- Mount Skokomish Wilderness, Olympic National Forest (summit/Sawtooth Ridge); the approach trail via Staircase lies within Olympic National Park.
expect.parking_pass: Olympic NP entrance fee: $30/vehicle (7-day), $55 annual Olympic NP pass, or $80 America the Beautiful interagency annual pass.
expect.passRequired: NPS entrance pass (or America the Beautiful pass) for vehicle/individual entry at the Staircase entrance station; no Northwest Forest Pass needed since the trailhead itself is inside the National Park boundary.
